drivingQuestion: How many mentions of sovereignty HaTov VeHaMetiv requires, and whether one who omitted Shabbat, a Festival or the New Moon from Grace after Meals returns to the beginning or recites a short blessing
outcomeNote: R' Zeira and Rav Pappa's readings of R' Yohanan stand side by side; the closing exchange resolves Rav's two rulings by R' Menashya bar Tahlifa's limitation, and on Shabbat and Festivals one who erred returns to the beginning

segments.he: אָמַר רַבָּה בַּר בַּר חָנָה אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: ״הַטּוֹב וְהַמֵּטִיב״ צְרִיכָה מַלְכוּת. מַאי קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן, כׇּל בְּרָכָה שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ מַלְכוּת — לֹא שְׁמָהּ בְּרָכָה? וְהָא אַמְרַהּ רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן חֲדָא זִימְנָא! אָמַר רַבִּי זֵירָא: לוֹמַר שֶׁצְּרִיכָה שְׁתֵּי מַלְכֻיוֹת, חֲדָא דִּידַהּ וַחֲדָא דְּ״בוֹנֵה יְרוּשָׁלָיִם״.
segments.en: «Rabba bar bar Ḥana said» that «Rabbi Yoḥanan said:» The blessing: «Who is good and does good, requires» mention of God’s «sovereignty.» The Gemara asks: «What is he teaching us» that we did not already know? If you say that he is teaching us that «any blessing that does not contain mention of» God’s «sovereignty is not» considered a «blessing, didn’t Rabbi Yoḥanan already say that» halakha «once? Rabbi Zeira said:» Rabba bar bar Ḥana «is saying that» the blessing: Who is good and does good, «requires two» mentions of «sovereignty, one for itself and one for» the blessing: «Who builds Jerusalem.»

segments.he: אִי הָכִי נִיבְעֵי תְּלָת: חֲדָא דִּידַהּ, וַחֲדָא דְּ״בוֹנֵה יְרוּשָׁלָיִם״, וַחֲדָא דְּבִרְכַּת הָאָרֶץ! אֶלָּא בִּרְכַּת הָאָרֶץ מַאי טַעְמָא לָא? מִשּׁוּם דְּהָוְיָיא לַהּ בְּרָכָה הַסְּמוּכָה לַחֲבֶרְתָּהּ, ״בּוֹנֵה יְרוּשָׁלָיִם״ נָמֵי לָא תִּבְעֵי, דְּהָוְיָא לַהּ בְּרָכָה הַסְּמוּכָה לַחֲבֶרְתָּהּ!
segments.en: The Gemara asks: «If so,» that God’s sovereignty must be mentioned a second time in the blessing: Who is good and does good, to compensate for the fact that it was not mentioned in the blessing: Who builds Jerusalem, «it should require three» mentions; «one of its own, one for» the blessing: «Who builds Jerusalem, and one for the blessing of the land,» in which sovereignty is also not mentioned. «Rather,» in «the blessing of the land, what is the reason» that sovereignty is «not» mentioned? «Because it is a blessing juxtaposed to another» preceding blessing. «Who builds Jerusalem, should also not require» its own mention of God’s sovereignty, «as it is a blessing juxtaposed to another» preceding blessing.

segments.he: הוּא הַדִּין דַּאֲפִילּוּ ״בּוֹנֵה יְרוּשָׁלָיִם״ נָמֵי לָא בָּעֲיָא. אַיְּידֵי דְּאָמַר מַלְכוּת בֵּית דָּוִד, לָאו אוֹרַח אַרְעָא דְּלָא אָמַר מַלְכוּת שָׁמַיִם. רַב פָּפָּא אָמַר, הָכִי קָאָמַר: צְרִיכָה שְׁתֵּי מַלְכֻיוֹת לְבַר מִדִּידַהּ.
segments.en: The Gemara responds: «The same is true even» with regard to the blessing: «Who builds Jerusalem,» that it «does not require» mention of sovereignty. However, «since he mentioned the royal house of David» in the blessing, «it would not be proper» if «he did not mention God’s sovereignty» as well. On the other hand, «Rav Pappa said:» The blessing: Who is good and does good, «requires two» mentions of «sovereignty besides its own;» one to compensate for its lack of mention in the blessing: Who builds Jerusalem, and one for the blessing of the land.

segments.he: יָתֵיב רַבִּי זֵירָא אֲחוֹרֵי דְּרַב גִּידֵּל, וְיָתֵיב רַב גִּידֵּל קַמֵּיהּ דְּרַב הוּנָא, וְיָתֵיב וְקָאָמַר: טָעָה וְלֹא הִזְכִּיר שֶׁל שַׁבָּת, אוֹמֵר: ״בָּרוּךְ שֶׁנָּתַן שַׁבָּתוֹת לִמְנוּחָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאַהֲבָה לְאוֹת וְלִבְרִית, בָּרוּךְ מְקַדֵּשׁ הַשַּׁבָּת״. אֲמַר לֵיהּ: מַאן אַמְרַהּ? רַב.
segments.en: The Gemara recounts: «Rabbi Zeira sat behind Rav Giddel» in the study hall, «and Rav Giddel sat before Rav Huna, and he sat and he said: One who erred and did not mention» the formula «for Shabbat» in Grace after Meals, «says» the following abridged version instead: «Blessed…Who gave Shabbatot for rest to His people Israel with love, as a sign and a covenant; Blessed…Who sanctifies the Shabbat.» Rav Huna «said to him: Who said» this halakha? He answered: «Rav.»

segments.he: הֲדַר יָתֵיב וְקָאָמַר: טָעָה וְלֹא הִזְכִּיר שֶׁל יוֹם טוֹב, אוֹמֵר: ״בָּרוּךְ שֶׁנָּתַן יָמִים טוֹבִים לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְשִׂמְחָה וּלְזִכָּרוֹן, בָּרוּךְ מְקַדֵּשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַזְּמַנִּים״. אֲמַר לֵיהּ: מַאן אַמְרַהּ? רַב.
segments.en: «Again» Rav Giddel «sat and said: One who erred and did not mention» the formula «for Festivals» in Grace after Meals, «says: “Blessed…Who gave Festivals to His people Israel for joy and for commemoration; Blessed…Who sanctifies Israel and the seasons.”» Rav Huna «said to him: Who said» this halakha? He answered: «Rav.»

segments.he: הֲדַר יָתֵיב וְקָאָמַר: טָעָה וְלֹא הִזְכִּיר שֶׁל רֹאשׁ חוֹדֶשׁ אוֹמֵר ״בָּרוּךְ שֶׁנָּתַן רָאשֵׁי חֳדָשִׁים לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְזִכָּרוֹן״. וְלָא יָדַעְנָא אִי אָמַר בָּהּ ״שִׂמְחָה״ אִי לָא אָמַר בָּהּ ״שִׂמְחָה״, אִי חָתֵים בָּהּ, אִי לָא חָתֵים בָּהּ, אִי דִּידֵיהּ אִי דְּרַבֵּיהּ.
segments.en: «Again» Rav Giddel «sat and said: If one erred and did not mention the New Moon, he says: “Blessed…Who gave the New Moon to His people Israel for commemoration.» Rabbi Zeira, who related this incident, said: «I do not know whether he mentioned joy in» the formula «or whether he did not mention joy, whether he concluded this» formula with a blessing as he did in the parallel formulas for Shabbat and Festivals «or if he did not conclude it» with a blessing; «and whether» this halakha «is his or whether it is his teacher» Rav’s statement.

segments.he: גִּידֵּל בַּר מִנְיוֹמֵי הֲוָה קָאֵי קַמֵּיהּ דְּרַב נַחְמָן, טְעָה רַב נַחְמָן
segments.en: The Gemara relates: «Giddel bar Manyumi was standing before Rav Naḥman, Rav Naḥman erred» and did not mention the special formula for Shabbat in Grace after Meals,

segments.he: וַהֲדַר לְרֵישָׁא. אֲמַר לֵיהּ: מַאי טַעְמָא עָבֵיד מָר הָכִי? אֲמַר לֵיהּ, דְּאָמַר רַבִּי שֵׁילָא אָמַר רַב: טָעָה — חוֹזֵר לָרֹאשׁ.
segments.en: «and he returned to the beginning» of Grace after Meals and repeated it. Giddel bar Manyumi «said to» Rav Naḥman: «Why did the master act in that manner? He said: As Rabbi Sheila said» that «Rav said: If one erred, he returns to the beginning.»

segments.he: וְהָא אָמַר רַב הוּנָא אָמַר רַב: טָעָה — אוֹמֵר ״בָּרוּךְ שֶׁנָּתַן״! אֲמַר לֵיהּ: לָאו אִיתְּמַר עֲלַהּ, אָמַר רַב מְנַשְּׁיָא בַּר תַּחְלִיפָא אָמַר רַב: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא שֶׁלֹּא פָּתַח בְּ״הַטּוֹב וְהַמֵּטִיב״, אֲבָל פָּתַח בְּ״הַטּוֹב וְהַמֵּטִיב״ — חוֹזֵר לָרֹאשׁ.
segments.en: Giddel bar Manyumi challenged: «Didn’t Rav Huna say» that «Rav said: If one erred, he recites: Blessed…Who gave?» Rav Naḥman «said to him: Wasn’t it stated about this» that «Rabbi Menashya bar Taḥlifa said» that «Rav said: They only taught that» one recites the short blessing in a case where «he did not» yet «begin» reciting: «Who is good and does good; however,» if «he» already «began» reciting: «Who is good and does good, he must return to the beginning» of Grace after Meals?

segments.he: אָמַר רַב אִידִי בַּר אָבִין אָמַר רַב עַמְרָם אָמַר רַב נַחְמָן אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: טָעָה וְלֹא הִזְכִּיר שֶׁל רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ בַּתְּפִלָּה — מַחֲזִירִין אוֹתוֹ. בְּבִרְכַּת הַמָּזוֹן — אֵין מַחֲזִירִין אוֹתוֹ.
segments.en: «Rav Idi bar Avin said» that «Rav Amram said» that «Rav Naḥman said» that «Shmuel said: If one erred and did not mention the» formula for the «New Moon in his» Amida «prayer, we require him to return» to the beginning of the prayer and repeat it. However, if one erred and forgot to mention the New Moon «in Grace after Meals, we do not require him to return» to the beginning and repeat it.

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב אָבִין לְרַב עַמְרָם: מַאי שְׁנָא תְּפִלָּה וּמַאי שְׁנָא בִּרְכַּת הַמָּזוֹן? אֲמַר לֵיהּ: אַף לְדִידִי קַשְׁיָא לִי וּשְׁאֵילְתֵּיהּ לְרַב נַחְמָן, וַאֲמַר לִי: מִינֵּיהּ דְּמָר שְׁמוּאֵל לָא שְׁמִיעַ לִי, אֶלָּא נֶחְזֵי אֲנַן: תְּפִלָּה דְּחוֹבָה הִיא — מַחֲזִירִין אוֹתוֹ. בִּרְכַּת מְזוֹנָא, דְּאִי בָּעֵי אָכֵיל אִי בָּעֵי לָא אָכֵיל — אֵין מַחֲזִירִין אוֹתוֹ.
segments.en: «Rav Avin said to Rav Amram» about this: «What is the difference between» the Amida «prayer and Grace after Meals? He said to him: That» question «was also difficult for me and I asked Rav Naḥman» about «it, and he said to me: I did not hear» the reason «from Mar Shmuel» himself, «but let us see» if we can analyze it ourselves. For the Amida «prayer, which is an obligation, we require him to return» to the beginning of the prayer and repeat it. For «Grace after Meals, which» is not an obligation, as «if he wants» to eat, «he eats and if he wants» not to eat, «he does not eat, we do not require him to return» to the beginning and repeat it. Grace after Meals is not a full-fledged obligation; it is dependent upon eating, which is optional. Consequently, failure to mention the New Moon in Grace after Meals is not a source of concern.

segments.he: אֶלָּא מֵעַתָּה שַׁבָּתוֹת וְיָמִים טוֹבִים, דְּלָא סַגִּי דְּלָא אָכֵיל — הָכִי נָמֵי דְּאִי טָעֵי הָדַר? — אֲמַר לֵיהּ: אִין, דְּאָמַר רַבִּי שֵׁילָא אָמַר רַב: טָעָה — חוֹזֵר לָרֹאשׁ. וְהָא אָמַר רַב הוּנָא אָמַר רַב: טָעָה — אוֹמֵר ״בָּרוּךְ שֶׁנָּתַן״! — לָאו אִיתְּמַר עֲלַהּ: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא שֶׁלֹּא פָּתַח בְּ״הַטּוֹב וְהַמֵּטִיב״, אֲבָל פָּתַח בְּ״הַטּוֹב וְהַמֵּטִיב״ — חוֹזֵר לָרֹאשׁ.
segments.en: The Gemara asks: «If so, on Shabbatot and Festivals,» when there is a mitzva to eat and «when it is not possible to refrain from eating,» there «too, if he erred» and failed to mention them in Grace after Meals, would you say that «he must return» to the beginning and repeat it? «He said: Yes. As Rabbi Sheila said» that «Rav said: If one erred, he returns to the beginning» of Grace after Meals. The Gemara asks: «Didn’t Rav Huna say» that «Rav said: If one erred, he recites: Blessed…Who gave?» The Gemara rejects this: «Wasn’t it stated about this: They only taught that» one recites the short blessing in a case where «he did not» yet «begin» reciting: «Who is good and does good; however,» if «he» already «began» reciting: «Who is good and does good, he must return to the beginning» of Grace after Meals.

moves.cueHe: אמר רבה בר בר חנה אמר רבי יוחנן
moves.summary: Rabba bar bar Hana transmits R' Yohanan: HaTov VeHaMetiv requires sovereignty
moves.about: HaTov VeHaMetiv requires mention of God's sovereignty

moves.cueHe: מאי קא משמע לן
moves.summary: the stam asks what the ruling adds
moves.about: what the ruling adds, since R' Yohanan already taught that a blessing without sovereignty is no blessing

moves.cueHe: כל ברכה שאין בה מלכות
moves.summary: suggests it teaches that a blessing without sovereignty is no blessing
moves.about: R' Yohanan's 'requires sovereignty' means two mentions, one of its own and one for Boneh Yerushalayim

moves.cueHe: והא אמרה רבי יוחנן חדא זימנא
moves.summary: rejects the suggestion: R' Yohanan already said that once

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי זירא
moves.summary: R' Zeira: it teaches that two mentions of sovereignty are needed, one for itself and one for Boneh Yerushalayim
moves.about: the ruling teaches that HaTov VeHaMetiv needs two mentions of sovereignty

moves.cueHe: אי הכי ניבעי תלת
moves.summary: if so, three should be needed, one also for the blessing of the land
moves.about: if the extra mention compensates for Boneh Yerushalayim, three should be required, one also for the blessing of the land

moves.cueHe: אלא ברכת הארץ מאי טעמא לא
moves.summary: asks why the blessing of the land needs no sovereignty
moves.about: why the blessing of the land needs no mention of sovereignty

moves.cueHe: משום דהוייא לה ברכה הסמוכה לחברתה
moves.summary: because it is juxtaposed to a preceding blessing
moves.about: the blessing of the land is juxtaposed to a preceding blessing and so needs no sovereignty

moves.cueHe: בונה ירושלים נמי לא תבעי
moves.summary: then Boneh Yerushalayim, also juxtaposed, should need no compensating mention either
moves.about: Boneh Yerushalayim is likewise juxtaposed to a preceding blessing, so it should need no compensating mention either

moves.cueHe: הוא הדין
moves.summary: indeed it needs none in principle, but having mentioned the kingdom of David one must mention the kingdom of Heaven
moves.about: Boneh Yerushalayim indeed needs none, but having mentioned the kingdom of David one must also mention the kingdom of Heaven

moves.cueHe: רב פפא אמר, הכי קאמר
moves.summary: Rav Pappa reads the ruling as two mentions besides its own
moves.about: the ruling means two mentions of sovereignty besides its own

moves.cueHe: יתיב רבי זירא אחורי דרב גידל
moves.summary: narrative frame: R' Zeira behind Rav Giddel, Rav Giddel before Rav Huna
moves.about: R' Zeira sat behind Rav Giddel in the study hall

moves.cueHe: ויתיב וקאמר: טעה ולא הזכיר של שבת
moves.summary: Rav Giddel: one who omitted Shabbat says the short 'Blessed…Who gave Shabbatot' blessing
moves.about: Rav Giddel sat before Rav Huna

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: מאן אמרה
moves.summary: Rav Huna asks who said it
moves.about: who is the authority behind the short-blessing formula for an omitted Shabbat

moves.cueHe: רב
moves.summary: Rav
moves.about: the halakha is Rav's

moves.cueHe: הדר יתיב וקאמר: טעה ולא הזכיר של יום טוב
moves.summary: Rav Giddel: one who omitted the Festival says the short 'Blessed…Who gave Festivals' blessing
moves.about: one who omitted the Festival in Grace says 'Blessed…Who gave Festivals'

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: מאן אמרה
moves.summary: Rav Huna asks who said it
moves.about: who is the authority behind the short-blessing formula for an omitted Festival

moves.cueHe: רב
moves.summary: Rav
moves.about: the halakha is Rav's

moves.cueHe: הדר יתיב וקאמר: טעה ולא הזכיר של ראש חודש
moves.summary: Rav Giddel: one who omitted the New Moon says 'Blessed…Who gave New Moons'
moves.about: the New Moon formula, with the narrator unsure of its wording, its closing, and whether it is Rav Giddel's own or Rav's

moves.cueHe: ולא ידענא
moves.summary: the narrator does not know whether 'joy' was said, whether it closed with a blessing, or whether it is Rav Giddel's own or Rav's

moves.cueHe: גידל בר מניומי הוה קאי קמיה דרב נחמן
moves.summary: Giddel bar Manyumi stood before Rav Nahman, who erred in Grace and returned to the beginning
moves.about: Rav Nahman erred in Grace and returned to the beginning

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: מאי טעמא עביד מר הכי
moves.summary: asks why Rav Nahman returned to the beginning
moves.about: why Rav Nahman returned to the beginning rather than reciting the short blessing

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה, דאמר רבי שילא אמר רב
moves.summary: per R' Sheila in Rav's name: one who erred returns to the beginning
moves.about: he acted per R' Sheila in Rav's name: one who erred returns to the beginning

moves.cueHe: והא אמר רב הונא אמר רב
moves.summary: but Rav Huna in Rav's name: one who erred says 'Blessed…Who gave'
moves.about: Rav's two rulings: one who erred returns to the beginning (R' Sheila) versus recites 'Blessed…Who gave' (Rav Huna)

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: לאו איתמר עלה
moves.summary: R' Menashya bar Tahlifa in Rav's name limited that to one who has not begun HaTov VeHaMetiv
moves.about: the short blessing applies only before beginning HaTov VeHaMetiv; after it one returns to the beginning

moves.cueHe: אמר רב אידי בר אבין אמר רב עמרם
moves.summary: chain to Shmuel: an omitted New Moon is repeated in the Amida but not in Grace
moves.about: an omitted New Moon: in the Amida one repeats, in Grace one does not

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה רב אבין לרב עמרם: מאי שנא
moves.summary: what is the difference between the Amida and Grace?
